quests.question: This person researches facts and writes news stories.
quests.hint: This person researches facts and writes news stories.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a journalist. Journalists research and write news stories for newspapers or TV.
quests.funFact: A journalist checks facts carefully before sharing a story.
quests.wordExample: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new park.

quests.question: This person digs up and studies objects from ancient times.
quests.hint: This person digs up and studies objects from ancient times.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an archaeologist. Archaeologists dig up and study objects from ancient times.
quests.funFact: An archaeologist might spend weeks carefully digging up a single ancient object!

quests.question: This person draws the plan for a building before it is built.
quests.hint: This person draws the plan for a building before it is built.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an architect. Architects design buildings before workers start to build them.
quests.funFact: An architect draws a careful plan before a single brick is placed!
